verdicts.claim: Orb ruled that Orb 2 has Orb's standing on flash and safety for private builds; RL-253 attaches conditions (warning on Orb 2's PC, lock on, adulthood by vouching, stop if minor/photosensitive/symptomatic, nobody else present, network terms unchanged).
verdicts.what_is_true: Orb's quote (vision.md:1665) and RL-253's conditions are as stated (commit c5b42dc1). But the committed kit still enforces RL-230's 'Only Orb plays and watches' line (lan_kit.mjs:192, lan_words.txt, same at a8bc66e2), so the folder Orb 2 played told them only Orb plays; lan-v1.md:89 and two-v-two-lan.md:157 still say Orb alone, and the new wording sits only in untracked docs/net/pending. Adulthood and non-photosensitivity rest on vouching; the warning and lock (AC-022) are the real screen.
verdicts.fix: Netcode lands RL-253's WHO PLAYS line in lan_words.txt and lan_kit.mjs:192 and updates lan-v1.md:89 and two-v-two-lan.md:157; Legal notes the landing in RL-253.
verdicts.belongs_to: Legal (record) and Netcode (kit words); private-build process

verdicts.claim: Flash warnings and photosensitivity questions are not put to Orb; private flash reads pause pending Tools' proof; calls go through the EP and Legal on Orb's delegation; public gates unchanged and anyone but Orb still gets the warning and Reduce flashing.
key_sources: homework/2 Up Next/09 Business - Legal's open questions (10 min).md:7
verdicts.what_is_true: RL-226 records the waiver as claimed and keeps the public gates and the warning for anyone but Orb; Orb's words exist only as relayed there. Tools' proof exists but stopped unfinished (flash-proof.md, 2026-11-01: repeatable at one size, not independent) and RL-226 has not logged it. Conflict: RL-212 (4) requires Orb's 2026-11-15 renewal of the public interim to name seed 1049's readings, while RL-226 and RL-253 bar raising flash with Orb.
verdicts.fix: Legal logs flash-proof.md's partial result in RL-226; the EP and Legal settle how the 2026-11-15 renewal gives Orb the RL-212 (4) facts, or record that the renewal is not informed consent.
verdicts.belongs_to: process (EP and Legal); Tools for the proof

verdicts.claim: Look gate (ADR 0010): no test result justifies a worse look, dissolves/fades/blur banned, safety met by warnings and settings; the warning, Reduce flashing lock and nightly seeds stay as safeguards while flash work is paused.
verdicts.what_is_true: ADR 0010 says this and the six charters carry it; it is Orb's look direction and does not lower the release gate (RL-226 keeps primary at most 2.5 in both modes), so main stays blocked rather than shipping worse. Of its safeguards, the warning and locked Reduce flashing are live on /play/, but the 'nightly seeds' are run by hand (nightly-seeds.mjs:2), with no schedule in ci.yml and 6 runs ever, the last on 2026-10-30.
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: Filing the look gate as a safety waiver suggests Orb traded safety for looks and invites re-arguing taste, while the real gap (a 'nightly' that has not run for a week) hides behind the word.
verdicts.fix: Take the look gate out of the safety records, keeping only the clause that safety is met by warnings and settings; Tools schedules the nightly or ADR 0010:18 is corrected to 'run by hand, last run 2026-10-30'.
verdicts.belongs_to: Orb's creative direction; the nightly safeguard to Tools

verdicts.claim: Private testers are told about flashing in the invitation and link message; private looping GIFs carry no warning so Orb warns; public clips are controlled videos with no autoplay or loop, read first; a photosensitive person is never a test.
verdicts.what_is_true: The conditions exist as stated. The LAN kit's words carry a flash warning (lan_words.txt) and neither live page has a video, GIF or autoplay; whether invitations or Orb's MMS GIFs carried a warning cannot be checked from the repo.
verdicts.fix: None needed for release; keep any invitation text beside the kit if proof is wanted.

verdicts.claim: Phones see a 'Best on a computer' note before the flashing notice; it never replaces or skips the notice, makes no promise, and Tools' wrapper deploy check holds its exact words on every deploy.
verdicts.what_is_true: The served /play/ page shows RL-201's words verbatim, to phones only, above the gate; its button removes only the note and un-inerts the gate. check-site-interim.mjs tests the words in the deploy job (ci.yml:514), which cannot run while ci.yml is dead, but nothing else can deploy either, so the live words stay as last checked.
verdicts.fix: None for safety; the check resumes when CI is fixed.

verdicts.claim: A store release needs an independent photosensitivity analyser report (Harding FPA, an equivalent or a test house), console requirements must be asked for, and the public notices say none has been run.
verdicts.what_is_true: The kernel is sound: the own analyser is unvalidated (flash-proof.md: 'not an independent check') and console terms are unread, so an outside check before a store release is prudent, and the notices do say none has been run. But no standard or store found requires a Harding report: WCAG lists it for information only and no Steamworks rule turned up, yet photosensitivity-note.md:21 calls a recognised tool 'the standard'; steam-readiness.md:39 already accepts the honest 'none has been run' line instead, with no ruling reconciling the two.
external: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/three-flashes-or-below-threshold.html (accessed 2026-11-07): Harding FPA and PEAT listed as resources "for information only"
WebSearch 2026-11-07: no Steamworks photosensitivity-analyser requirement found; the Steamworks partner docs themselves were not reached
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: A paid test house becomes a hard store gate under a zero budget, and two contradictory Legal records leave the store gate undefined.
verdicts.fix: Correct the record: state the independent check as Legal's recommended margin, reconcile it with steam-readiness D4, and have Tools finish flash-proof.md's accuracy comparison (PEAT or equivalent); ask console makers only if a console port is planned.
verdicts.belongs_to: Legal, with Tools for the comparison

verdicts.claim: Pin move to main: only a reduced clip over 3.5 primary triggers a take-down, a normal one over 3.5 is a finding while the route check passes; one batch of clips; the public pack has no art/ or docs/ and keeps the notice, lock line, AI line and licences screen.
verdicts.what_is_true: RL-208 says this and nightly-seeds.mjs implements it (reduced over the limit = take-down, normal over while the route check passes = finding, exit 4). docs/ is excluded; art/animation and art/concepts carry .gdignore at HEAD and the pin, and the only other art files are 23 .md prompts, which an all_resources export does not pack (not verified by an export). The move has not happened (pin 257a766c) and RL-209 blocks it.
verdicts.fix: None now; when a move is tried, keep a listing of the .pck contents as the proof of no art/ or docs/.

verdicts.claim: The worse of two sizes and two scales counts; the move to main does not stand (main reduced 3.5/3.5/3 at 16:9 vs the pin's 3/3/3), so the demo stays on a strings-only child and flash work stays paused on Orb's delegation.
verdicts.what_is_true: RL-209 says this and the gate holds: site.json still pins 257a766c. But the demo is on the pin itself, not a child (built only in scratch, due 2026-11-08, undeployable while ci.yml is dead); the readings come from Tools' docs with no saved output; and the 0.91/1.23 margin RL-209 gives for main's signature clip is Tools' collapse-normal first-blast figure (load-and-captures.md:29).
verdicts.fix: Correct RL-209's margin sentence; save Tools' four-reading tables as output files; record that the child cannot deploy until CI is fixed, so RL-200's ride to 2026-11-15 is the real path.

verdicts.claim: New tripwire: the interim take-down also fires on an area-15% reading over 4.5 on any reduced clip or a primary over 3.5 at either size; a reduced clip at 3.5 primary at 16:9 blocks any pin move until explained.
verdicts.what_is_true: The tripwire is in code and self-tested, but it fires only when someone runs the nightly by hand: no schedule exists and the last of 6 runs was 2026-10-30. The second capture of ai-1049-reduced and seed 1055 are not done (pin-child.md:41), and a take-down cannot deploy while ci.yml is dead. The live pin's only mode already reads 3.5 primary on seeds 1049 and 1050 at 960x540, at the line.
verdicts.fix: Tools runs the nightly on a schedule at below-normal priority, or Legal records the tripwire as dormant; fix ci.yml so tools/site-offline.mjs can deploy.

verdicts.claim: The flash warning shows before play on both PCs with no bypass, and the LAN kit locks Reduce flashing on, stopping if the flag or capture hook is wrong.
verdicts.what_is_true: lan_kit.mjs locks Reduce flashing and stops if the lock is off or the capture hook on; its patch skips the start menu only for --lan-loop on a headless display, and bypass_allowed() returns false in a locked build, so the menu's warning shows. Nobody on the team has observed it in a window (lan-v1.md:80, 93).

verdicts.claim: Flash rule k06: a persistent HUD cue changes no faster than 3 a second (2 preferred), is static under Reduce flashing and Reduced motion and counts in the flash check; the UI's 4 Hz crown stroke must drop to 3 Hz or less.
verdicts.what_is_true: The 4 Hz stroke is gone: HZ_BATTERED is 2.0 at HEAD and at the live pin since 18d05091 (2026-10-12), and hud_check asserts every HUD rate at most 3 Hz and the whole-match ones at most 2, yet RL-130 still reads Open. Residual: the stroke goes static only under Reduced motion, not Reduce flashing (the crown reads only reduced_motion), so k06's wording is not fully met, at 2 Hz in thin arcs.
verdicts.fix: Close RL-130 citing 18d05091; UI makes the stroke static under Reduce flashing too, or Legal narrows k06 to Reduced motion.

verdicts.claim: The world swing needs an Accessibility motion-sensitivity review before it ships (RL-213 (7)); the review sets a setting that turns the swing into a plain cut or still, cuts counted in the flash register, at least 4 s apart, no roll under the setting.
verdicts.what_is_true: The review is paper with no motion-sensitive tester, and the 4 s spacing is its author's first value. The setting exists and is wired and tested (world_turning auto/full/cut; split_rig.gd:5517; main.gd:1107). The swing switch is off at HEAD and a8bc66e2 and absent from the live pin. swing-motion.md:28-30 proposes a lobby-set sim flag against ADR 0012 item 3, but none is built.
verdicts.fix: Legal records world_turning as RL-213 (7)'s setting; Accessibility reshapes the sim-flag idea to fit ADR 0012; a motion-sensitive read before the swing goes public.

verdicts.claim: The records conflict on a reduced-motion dissolve: the accessibility audit wants it kept as an opt-in and camera_params.gd:226 cites a Legal 0.3 s minimum, while the swing review says plain cut, ADR 0010 bans dissolves and Legal withdrew the 0.3 s ask.
verdicts.what_is_true: The records disagree, but no build dissolves: cut_dissolve is false at HEAD and the pin, and the only caller of set_cut_dissolve passes false. What is left is stale text: camera_params.gd:226 still says 'Legal asks at least 0.3', split_view.gd:314 still says '(default on)' though RL-229 asked for that fix, and audit-2026-10-28.md:88-92 describes a fade the help text now calls 'one step'.
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: Reviewers chase a conflict with no player effect, and the stale comment could be used to revive a dissolve Orb banned on the strength of a withdrawn Legal ask.
verdicts.fix: Camera fixes the two code comments, Accessibility corrects the audit lines, and the item leaves the safety records.

verdicts.claim: The camera must prevent motion sickness with smoothing and limits on shake and zoom rate; Reduced motion (off by default) removes flicker and rings, makes the split swing a near-cut and quarters shake; shake runs 0-10 (default 2); head flashes can be turned off.
verdicts.what_is_true: The options exist and are wired: the shake setting reaches the camera and Reduced motion quarters it; zoom is capped at 1.2, 2.4 and 3.0 e-folds a second; reduced motion gives near-cuts; head flashes have an off switch. docs/camera/framing-rules.md does not exist, the audit's 'quick fade' is stale, and nobody has tested the limits with motion-sensitive players.
verdicts.fix: Camera writes the promised framing-rules doc or drops the reference; Accessibility updates the audit wording.

verdicts.claim: Beam 'air and light' alerts stay small, steady and unpulsed: no sky dimming, wash or blur, a thin edge light with a 6-tick ramp that never blinks (also for 2v2 beam_warn), Reduce flashing turns the strong setting off, and alert bursts need analyser clips at Standard and Full, both modes, day and night.
verdicts.what_is_true: The edge line ramps over 6 ticks and never blinks, Reduce flashing steps strong air, bright glint and thick line down, and beam_warn feeds the same alert. Not checked: the air-and-light VFX themselves; the Standard and Full clips have not been run. The alert is in the private a8bc66e2 build but not the live pin, so the pin-move batch would catch it.
verdicts.fix: Run the alert clips before any pin move that carries the alert, as RL-227 (6) requires; nothing now.
verdicts.belongs_to: UI and VFX; Legal for the clip gate
